morgen

tomorrow

A1 assistant

Part of speech
adverb
Topic
Alltag
View source Edit in the editor Edit on the git server
Contents
  • Examples
  • Notes

Examples

  • Morgen gehe ich zum Training. Tomorrow I am going to training.

Notes

morgen is tomorrow. der Morgen is the morning: heute Morgen, this morning.

Where it appears

  • Vollpension heißt Buffet am Morgen, Mittag und Abend. Full board means a buffet in the morning, at midday and in the evening. Infos zur Spanienfahrt 2027

  • Grundschule, Sekretariat, guten Morgen. Primary school, office, good morning. Anruf im Sekretariat model
